name: Generous Heart Sangha
reason: Too thin (fewer than about 3 items): its own site (sites.google.com/shinki.org/generous-heart, opened 13 Nov 2026) offers only weekday Zoom sittings (password by email; schedule notes still refer to 2020-21) and a Wednesday noon sitting at a Bainbridge Island yoga studio; its Bainbridge Sunday sits list only 2023 dates ("2024 TBD"), the meditation-instructions page links to other teachers' material, and there are no talks, videos or other resources of its own. Lay sangha led by Mark Lancaster (email mark@shinki.org published); owner may revisit.
